title: Migration: moving boxes
label: Two buildings side by side. On the left, a cramped old office with cluttered shelves holds four labelled moving boxes: Spreadsheets, 12,400 rows; Old CRM, 3,200 contacts; Shared drive, 940 files; and Custom fields, marked fragile. A hand truck takes them one at a time along the walkway, past a checkpoint post that counts each box and shows 0 lost, into a clean new building. Inside, each box opens and its contents file into the matching room, whose count rises as they land. The fragile box arrives intact with its sticker. A progress line, counted from the boxes delivered, ends at imported 4 of 4, 0 lost.
heading:
Move in.
Nothing gets
left behind.
sub: Bring the spreadsheets, the old CRM and the shared drive. Every box is unpacked into the right room.
